title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.

title: Ramakrishna
desc: Ramakrishna, a millionaire, stays with his mother and is not in touch with anyone from his family. After her death, he decides to go to the village in search of his long-lost relatives.

title: Marumagan
desc: Thangarasu, a humble tailor, falls for Manjula, the daughter of a corrupt politician. Subsequently, her mother opposes their love while her father seeks to exploit their relationship for his own gain.

title: Karuthamma
desc: A woman, who lives in a village where female infanticide is a common practice, goes to great lengths to get justice when her sister and her newborn child are murdered in cold blood.
